name: What Is the Pi Coding Agent? How It Works and How to Use It
description: Pi is an open-source coding agent that runs in your terminal. It gives a model four tools by default, read, bash, edit and write, saves every session as a tree you can branch, and leaves out features like sub-agents and plan mode on purpose ...
